title: Wave type identification
description: Essential: Student correctly identifies radar waves as electromagnetic waves.

title: Wave speed value
description: Essential: Student states the correct speed of electromagnetic waves in air/vacuum (3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).

title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the wavelength using λ = c/f, yielding 2 × 10⁻² m.

title: Distance interpretation
description: Important: Student recognizes that the given time intervals correspond to round-trip times and correctly halves them to find one-way distances.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important: Student correctly sets up the distances x₁ = c·t₁/2 and x₂ = c·t₂/2, accounting for the plane moving toward the radar.

title: Plane displacement calculation
description: Important: Student correctly calculates the plane's displacement as Δx = x₁ - x₂ = (c/2)(t₁ - t₂) = 300 m.

title: Speed calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly computes the plane's speed as v = Δx/Δt, where Δt = 0.8 s, yielding 375 m/s.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly treats the time difference as t₂ - t₁, resulting in a negative speed or wrong magnitude.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student explicitly shows unit conversions or dimensional analysis, especially for time intervals.
